title: Status observation
description: One reading of one item of one module, as a status hub collector records it (homelabnext.status, ADR-0013). source is a registry status-source id; link is a logical id or a relative path, never an address. expires_at is when the reading reads as stale if nothing newer arrives (observed_at + the source's stale_after_s). Evolve additively.

link.description: A logical id (svc:metrics, cap:notify, inv:O-05) or a path relative to the docs, never a URL or an address.

value.description: Optional measure (a count, an age in seconds).

work.description: The item counts live work (an inbox, a queue): shown in the live-work strip while value > 0.
